title: Policy-Number Amendments When the Certified Policy Is Replaced — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Desk Reference
content:
## Subject

When the named insured replaces the certified policy with a new Cardinal policy, a policy-number amendment moves the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate onto the replacement policy and tells the ordering state its policy number, so that the certificate does not end with the policy it names.

The policy-number amendment charge is the amount booked for it, once per policy-number amendment, on its transmission.

## Condition on the filing's record

A policy-number amendment charge is fixed only after every state rejection recorded on the filing is answered on the filing's record by a corrected refiling transmission.

Restated: as long as the filing's record holds a state rejection with no corrected refiling transmission after it on that record, the policy-number amendment charge is not fixed.

## What the policy-number amendment records

- the filing certifies the replacement policy given;
- one amendment entry on the filing's record with the reason policy number change, tied to the transaction that issued the replacement policy;
- one amendment transmission to the ordering state under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason amended filing on that transmission, in the amount given.

The filing's status does not change. The customer sees the certificate under the new policy and the charge on the filing history.

## Invocation

**Tool:** `amend_certificate_policy_9772f7fb` — an agent-side tool; the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate being moved, as returned by the filing lookup for the household | Identifier |
| `new_policy_id` | The policy reference number of the replacement policy the certificate will certify, as returned by the policy lookup for the customer | Identifier |
| `issue_transaction_id` | The transaction reference number of the full-term premium entry that issued the replacement policy, as returned by the policy transaction history | Identifier |
| `policy_amendment_charge` | The policy-number amendment charge to book | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

The tool records the charge it is given and does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the replacement policy it now certifies, the new transmission confirmation number of the amendment (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the amendment and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.
